title: MaxSold Raw Auction Images
subtitle: Image data from MaxSold auctions
description: Raw image data scraped from MaxSold auctions. Contains 15,713 images from 100 auctions. Images are organized by auction ID in subfolders, with filenames in format: auctionID_itemID_imageID.webp. All images are resized to 256px max dimension and saved in WebP format for efficient storage.
